summary: A realtime 1v1 on Comet Catcher: one Opus 5.5 seat (Cortex, G1) under an Opus 5.5 commander against [gecko]u6bkep (Armada, B5), lost at 13:48. The opening was slow (plant at 1:08 behind three extractors and three solars; two extractors at 3:00 against the pool's p25 of 5), and from 2:33 his Rovers and then Blitzes raided the home spots, killing 6 extractors and 7 Incisors by 5:51. From then to the end the side held 4 extractors: with 3 to 6 constructors and about 70 free spots after 4:56 it began one extractor before 12:00, because the packet walked constructors to the commander whenever an enemy was in reach and the player put expansion off until the raids stopped. Meanwhile the commander, Pounders and Guards killed 45 Blitzes at home, and the seen trade went positive (5,153 destroyed to 4,645 lost at 10:22). A single roving Rascal killed 13 of his extractors in the A and B columns from 8:49 to 12:31, our only damage in his half. His 10:01 wave killed three of six constructors reclaiming at F1/F2; five Stouts and three Janus killed the plant at 11:51, razed the base and caught the commander at the new plant at spot_17.

root.what: The constructors were tied to home. From the 4:48 packet on, a constructor with an enemy in reach walked to the commander, with his raiders in our half every minute and lone Blitzes parked at outer spots. From 5:56 the player also put off the raid, and from 8:00 the expansion, until 'his Blitz waves stop'. After 4:56 the side began one extractor before 12:00, with 3 to 6 constructors and about 70 free spots, though raids took only two more extractors in that span; extractors stayed at 4 and metal income at 11 to the end. The earlier losses (the slow opening, the 4:00-5:30 raids) were still recoverable at 4:00, with 6 extractors (the pool's p25) and an army above its p75. This root is the reader's reading; no person commented on the game.

our_mistakes.what: Constructors were held at home for seven minutes. The packet's rule walked every constructor to the commander whenever an enemy was in reach. With his raiders in our half every minute and lone Blitzes parked at spot_25 and spot_17, that rule froze the outer lists, and the player then chose to wait for the raids to stop (5:56, 8:00). The commander's direction at 9:20 says the opposite: 'Expansion does not wait for his Blitz waves to stop, because they will not stop.' A stronger player keeps taking spots away from his approach (the east and south strip, G3-H8), each with its turret, and sends two soldiers at a parked raider at once.
our_mistakes.evidence: record: one cormex begun 4:56-12:00 (7:42); impedance-review: 28 step-waits, 'corllt spot_25 waited from 5:22 to 7:02'; 7:25 packet's 'send two Incisors at it' rated 0.49-0.58, not played

our_mistakes.what: The opening was slow on extractors. The plant came at 1:08 after three solars, and the first constructor spent its first minute on the plant and a solar while the commander stood at a blocked site. The side had two extractors at 3:00. A stronger opening has the plant up by about 0:50 and sends the first constructor straight to the H2/H3 spots: 5 extractors at 3:00.
our_mistakes.evidence: pro_baseline 'first factory standing 1:26 | 0:53 1:07 1:20 >p75'; 'income 7 | 12/14/16 <p25' at 3:00; hands_window 1:47 'constructor_16990: help plant_23436 build', 2:09 'build a corsolar'; impedance-review item 9

their_play: u6bkep played Armada from B5, with a vehicle plant at B4 (first seen 9:11, with a nano and nine solars). He opened with Rovers: one at 2:33 killed spot_5, and six at 3:53 killed two home extractors before the commander and the Guards killed all six. From 4:21 he sent Blitzes into our western home (F1, F2, G1, G2) in waves of 6 to 11 about every 1.5 minutes (4:26, 6:22, 7:41, 8:46, 10:07), parked lone Blitzes on outer spots (spot_25 for 145 s), and lost 45 Blitzes and 14 Rovers doing it. The waves held us at 4 extractors. From 10:07 he added Stouts, then Janus, which outreach the commander and the Guards' line; five Stouts and the Janus killed the plant at 11:51, and eight Stouts and three Janus caught the commander at 13:48. His mass stood 100% in our half from minute 3, and he showed no tier 2. His seen losses came to 7,609 metal by 13:24, against our 9,484. With no truth file, his economy is unseen; he held at least 13 extractors in the A and B columns, which our Rascal killed. He said nothing in the chat.

bears_on.note: Lost on extractors, not at home. The side held 4 extractors from 5:00 to the end while winning the fights at home (seen trade 5,153 to 4,645 at 10:22), until Stouts and Janus arrived.
One extractor begun between 4:56 and 12:00 with 3 to 6 constructors and about 70 free spots. This opponent was the human player of game 7, of whom the lesson says he took mexes 'so much faster'.
One roving Rascal (26 metal) killed 13 of his extractors in the A and B columns from 8:49 to 12:31, while his army was in our half.

His first handful did it to us: Rovers at 2:33 and six at 3:53 held us at 2 to 4 extractors. Our first kill of a building of his came at 8:49 (pool p75 5:08); our Incisors crossed at 2:56 and 3:15 and turned back within 17 s.

His six-Rover raid killed two extractors and died whole to the commander and the Guards (4:13-4:21). Our Rascal's rove footwork (code, since 2026-10-07) killed nothing for six minutes, then 13 extractors.
A converter at 6:34 on 4 extractors, with energy full and metal 0, on the map Irishstud14 called metal-heavy.

Three solars and a constructor as the plant's first unit (1:28), as the lesson intends. Even so, the store was empty at 1:54 with the commander and the constructor both on the plant, and the plant started at 1:08 (pool p75 1:01).
The commander assisted the plant 51 s of the first 4:00 (floor assist4 51), then stood 46 s at a blocked solar site (2:08-2:54).
The 2,250 metal at F1/F2 was taken by every builder at 9:22 and lifted income to 78. With no cover on the Blitz approach, the 10:01 wave killed three of six constructors.
'all pounder if I am getting pushed': Pounders with the commander and Guards from 5:37 killed 35 Blitzes at home between 6:22 and 10:25, after Incisors had traded 1:1 with Blitzes.
Against our static home defence of Pounders, Guards and the commander, he switched to Stouts (350) and Janus (380), which outreach both; they killed the plant at 11:51. This is the reader's reading.
The first constructor stood 30 s in the plant's exit lane (2:24 wake).

lens.caveats: No ledger row for human-27. The main session's review of 2026-10-08 survives only as commit 6ea433b's message ('Four fixes from the human-27 review (the user's word)'), all about 1:47-2:54. No person commented: the chat holds only our 'gl hf'. There is no truth file, so his army and economy are floors, pro_baseline's pressure rows are blank and floor's known%/look_min read '-'. There is no results.jsonl, so floor and analyze_match show no outcome; the loss at 13:48 is from the record's end with the commander at 11%. pro_baseline needed --all-starts --faction any (G1 not carded). Where this row differs from the impedance review: it rated the 9:22 reclaim moment clean, but the 10:01 wave killed three of the six constructors at F1/F2. The root is the reader's reading.

open_questions: What was u6bkep's economy? With no truth file, the replay is the only source; our Rascal alone killed 13 of his extractors in the A and B columns.
Why did the roving Rascal kill nothing from 2:51 to 8:49 and then 13 extractors in under four minutes: were his corner spots taken late, or did his army leave them when the waves went to our half?
Why did the engine refuse the extractor at spot_6 (G1) at 9:43 ('the site was bad'): a heap or wreck on the dead extractor's place?
Would spots on the east and south strip (G3-H8), each with a Guard, have held? Lone Blitzes reached spot_25 (H3) twice.
The commander's 5:50 note says 'the brief's "go now" does not apply while behind'. Did the brief of the time steer both the player and the commander to 'home first'?
